summary: Per-repo test-command config DONE (commit 064ac9e on main; DAEMON RESTART REQUIRED to activate — live :8787 untouched). Config shape: overlay.config.test_cmds = { "<ABSOLUTE repo path>": "<shell cmd>" }, persisted with the rest of the workspace config. STORE/RETRIEVE ONLY — daemon never executes it; agents (nightly QA) run it. SET: POST /config { test_cmds: { <abs path>: <cmd> } } (merge semantics, falsy clears, keys validated absolute BEFORE any mutation → 400) / new MCP tool set_repo_test_cmd(repo_path, test_cmd?). READ: surfaces as `test_cmd` on /task/detail (get_task_detail) and /git/status (git_status) — QA agent gets repo path + test_cmd in one call via task_key. Files: lib/overlay.js (setTestCmd/testCmdFor), daemon.js (/config + 2 read surfaces), lib/mcp-core.js (catalog entry), test/test-cmd.test.js (new, 16/16). Tests: full unit suite 29 files / 495 assertions, 0 fail (incl. fa5ac23's graph-delta additions); smoke 74 passed / 11 failed = exact pre-existing baseline (known stale singleton-loop failures, no NEW ones); endpoint behavior also verified live on isolated :8798.
